WITH circuit_averages AS (
  SELECT
    c.circuitId,
    c.country,
    AVG(r.round) AS avg_round
  FROM circuits AS c
  JOIN races AS r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  GROUP BY c.circuitId, c.country
),
country_averages AS (
  SELECT country, AVG(avg_round) AS country_avg_round
  FROM circuit_averages
  GROUP BY country
)
SELECT
  ca.circuitId,
  ca.country,
  ca.avg_round,
  ca.avg_round - co.country_avg_round AS difference
FROM circuit_averages AS ca
JOIN country_averages AS co ON ca.country = co.country
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
